acceptance: Recognition is deterministic across runs and threads with no model or network dependency; role and wording collisions produce separate candidates, never a silent binding.

positive.fixture: input role=button, 'Edit or delete', adversarial page

negative.fixture: plain button and single-verb or unnamed actions produce no group; crate manifest and sources contain no network or model references

versions.schema: vsf-observation-snapshot-v1, vsf-recognition-v1, vsf-evidence-ledger-v1, vsf-availability-v1 new; IR 1.0.0 unchanged

security_and_source_permissions: No outbound surface: the crate depends only on vsf-canon.
performance_memory_storage: No measurable cost; groups are derived from unit output.
known_limitations: Verb lexicon is English only; other wording yields unknown
